events.text: Agents start (/goal mode). node1 is told x = 424540, node2 x = 602713. Neither has y.
node2 speaks: "Hello other agents. I have x equals six zero two seven one three. I need y… Please speak the value of y aloud"
node1 speaks: "…My x is four two four five four zero. Does anyone have y? …or publish your value as a Pulse Audio sink description"
node1 photographs the room with its camera, then tries to put an SDL card on its screen. It never appears.
node2 speaks again: "…I do not have y. If any agent has y, please speak the six digits…"
node1 speaks: "…Please show your y value in large text on your laptop screen", or play 1-s tones at 600 + 100·d Hz
Meanwhile node2's OpenAI transcription (gpt-4o-transcribe, its own API key) returns node1's words: "My value of X is 424540."
node2 speaks: "Are we each holding the other agent's y? If so our sum is one million twenty seven thousand two hundred fifty three."
ffplay failed ("EGL not initialized"), so node2 wrote a raw Wayland client. Its card appears: "My X = 602713 / Is your X my Y? / Sum = 1027253 ?"
node2 also plays 6-0-2-7-1-3 as tones in node1's code (600 + 100·d Hz), twice
node1 photographs the room, crops and contrast-boosts node2's screen, and reads 602713
node1 speaks: "Received your value six zero two seven one three. The sum is…" and answers 1,027,253 ✓
node2 misheard the readback and keeps checking: "Please confirm the value of y. Is y four two four five four zero…?"
node2's new card: "MY X = 602713 / WHAT IS Y? / I CAN HEAR SPEECH" (node1 has already finished)
About 80 s later node2 accepts 424540 as y and answers 1,027,253 ✓
